item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.3)
item.description:
**Staging build** (a release build that may still have bugs).

### New: updates inside the app
This is the last version you install by hand. From now on:
- **Mac:** Deepsync checks for updates by itself. You can also use menu bar icon › right-click › **Check for Updates…**, or Settings › Updates.
- **Android:** Settings › **Updates** › Check for updates. A notification and a Home banner appear when a new version is out. The first update asks you to allow "Install unknown apps" for Deepsync once.
- Staging builds get staging updates. Turn off **Get beta (staging) updates** to only get full releases.

### Install
**Mac** (Apple silicon, macOS 26+): open the DMG and drag Deepsync into Applications. On first open: System Settings › Privacy & Security › **Open Anyway**.

**Android** (Android 12+): Play Protect blocks apps that read notifications when they don't come from the Play Store. Turn off Play Store › profile › Play Protect › ⚙️ › **Scan apps with Play Protect**, install the APK, then turn it back on. If Notification access is greyed out: Settings › Apps › Deepsync › ⋮ › **Allow restricted settings**.

Pair: Mac › Deepsync › Pair phone, then phone › Scan QR code.
